question: Câu 601: Minh ______ an interesting novel at the moment. He will lend it to you when he has finished it.
explanation: Dấu hiệu “at the moment” → thì hiện tại tiếp diễn.

question: Câu 602: The police asked Jane how many people ______ while they ______ to put out the fire.
options: had been injured – had been trying
had been being injured – had tried
explanation: Câu tường thuật + lùi thì: quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn cho hành động đang diễn ra trong quá khứ.

question: Câu 603: Let's go to the hospital and visit him, ______?
explanation: Câu rủ Let's → câu hỏi đuôi shall we.

question: Câu 604: I don't know ________.
options: why they all looked so sad
why did they all look so sadly
what did it make them look so sad
why they all looked so sadly
explanation: Câu tường thuật: không đảo ngữ + look + adj.

question: Câu 605: I feel that you should do more to help her, ______ ?
explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi theo mệnh đề phụ: you should → shouldn't you.

question: Câu 606: The Roman people are believed ______ to Europe around the beginning of the last millenium.
explanation: be believed + to have + VpII (đã làm gì trong quá khứ).

question: Câu 607: He was carried off the field with a slight ______ arising from sports.
explanation: concussion: chấn động não / va chạm nhẹ ở đầu.

question: Câu 608: “Did you have a good time at the Browns?” – “Not really. I ______ I’ll ever visit them again.
explanation: I don't think + clause: tôi không nghĩ rằng...

question: Câu 609: You cannot easily find ______ social relationships when you go online.
explanation: genuine: đích thực, thật sự (mối quan hệ).

question: Câu 610: The prisoner is thought ________ by climbing over the wall.
explanation: be thought + to have + VpII.

question: Câu 611: A washing machine of this type will certainly ______ normal domestic use.
explanation: stand up for: chịu được, phù hợp với.

question: Câu 612: I was promised a good job from January this year, but it's April now and I'm afraid that they are just ______ me along.
explanation: string sb along: lừa dối ai trong thời gian dài.

question: Câu 613: Team sports are good for learning accountability, ________, and leadership, among many other traits.
explanation: dedication: sự tận tâm.

question: Câu 614: At the end of the race my stamina gave out and I lost the race.
explanation: stamina (sức chịu đựng) >< pusillanimity (yếu đuối, hèn nhát).

question: Câu 615: John: “Last year, we went to one of those resorts where everything - food and drink - is free.” Thomas: “_________”
options: Wow! I didn't realise you were such snobs!
Really? I prefer to go somewhere a bit quieter.
It sounds great. I've never been on an all-inclusive holiday.
If you want all your meals and drinks included, you can stay on an all-inclusive basis.
explanation: Đáp lại tích cực, phù hợp ngữ cảnh nghỉ trọn gói.

question: Câu 616: John: “Do you think that we should use public transportation to protect our environment?” Laura: “_________.”
options: There is no doubt about it
explanation: There is no doubt about it: hoàn toàn đồng ý.

question: Câu 617: Ash: "I'm thinking of going to the Hotdog Festival." Ben: "_________"
options: Yeah, once a year, only in summer.
You must be kidding. It's 120 dollars a day.
Not that expensive. I can afford tickets for all of us.
explanation: What on Earth is that: thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên, không biết.

question: Câu 618: “Sorry to interrupt you but could I have a word here?” - “_________”
options: Could you just wait until I finish?
explanation: Lịch sự yêu cầu đợi đến khi mình nói xong.

question: Câu 619: a. Don't worry, we'll find it. Let's check the garden first. b. Oh no, that's terrible! I hope we find it soon. c. My bird flew away! I can't find it anywhere. d. I'm so sorry to hear that. Would you like me to help you look?
explanation: Thứ tự: nêu vấn đề → thông cảm + đề nghị giúp → gợi ý tìm → an ủi.

question: Câu 620: a. How far is it from here? b. Sure! Go straight down this road and take the second left. c. It's about a five-minute walk. You'll see it on your right. d. Can you help me find the nearest pharmacy?
explanation: Thứ tự: hỏi đường → chỉ đường → hỏi khoảng cách → trả lời khoảng cách.

question: Câu 621: a. That sounds interesting! I've never tried it before. What do I need to get started? b. I'm really into painting. It's a great way to unwind and be creative. c. Just some basic tools, seeds, and a bit of patience. It's really rewarding. d. I've been thinking about picking up a new hobby. Any suggestions? e. I'll look into it. What about you? What's your favorite hobby? f. How about gardening? It's relaxing and you can grow your own plants.
options: d - e - b - f - a - c
d - f - e - b - a - c
d - a - c - e - b - f
d - f - a - c - e - b
explanation: Thứ tự: hỏi gợi ý → đề xuất → hỏi cách bắt đầu → hướng dẫn → hỏi lại → trả lời sở thích.

question: Câu 622: a. Small actions like using public transport, reducing energy consumption, and supporting green initiatives can make a difference. b. I've been reading about the impact of air pollution lately. It sounds pretty serious. c. Absolutely! Trees absorb pollutants and improve air quality, so planting them is very beneficial. d. What can we do to help reduce it? e. That makes sense. I've also heard that planting more trees helps. f. Yes, it's a major issue. Poor air quality can lead to health problems and environmental damage.
options: b – f – d – a – e – c
d – a – b – f – e – c
b – c – f – d – a – e
b – f – e – c – d – a
explanation: Thứ tự logic về ô nhiễm không khí và giải pháp.

question: Câu 623: Growth is of very immediate environmental concern because ______, the more pollutants we throw out into the atmosphere.
options: the more the world economy grows
the more economy the world grows
the more grows the world economy
the more the world grows economy
explanation: Cấu trúc the more + S + V, the more...

question: Câu 624: Had it not been for the dead of the Prime Minister, the bill would have been passed.
explanation: Sửa dead → death (danh từ).

question: Câu 625: All the way along the winding street came he.
explanation: Với đại từ nhân xưng: giới từ + địa điểm + S + V → he came.

question: Câu 626: ______ down to dinner than the telephone rang again.
explanation: No sooner + had + S + VpII + than...

question: Câu 627: Quang won a scholarship. We are excited about that fact.
options: The fact being excited us had won Quang a scholarship.
Quang's excited about a scholarship's having won us.
We're excited about Quang's having won a scholarship.
We won Quang's excitement about the fact of a scholarship.
explanation: excited about + possessive + V-ing.

question: Câu 628: The taxi driver ignored the stop sign. Then, he crashed his vehicle.
options: If the taxi driver ignored the stop sign, he crashed his vehicle.
Unless the taxi driver paid attention to the stop sign, he would have crashed his vehicle.
The taxi driver would not have crashed his vehicle if he had taken notice of the stop sign.
The taxi driver didn't ignore the stop sign, or he would not have crashed his vehicle.
explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: would not have + VpII if had + VpII.

question: Câu 629: She is so attractive. Many boys run after her.
options: So attractive is she many boys that run after her.
So attractive is she that many boys run after her.
So attractive she is that many boys run after her.
So that attractive she is many boys that run after her.
explanation: Đảo ngữ: So + adj + be + S + that...

question: Câu 630: The plan may be ingenious. It will never work in practice.
options: Ingenious as it may be, the plan will never work in practice.
Ingenious as may the plan, it will never work in practice.
The plan may be too ingenious to work in practice.
The plan is as impractical as it is ingenious.
explanation: Adj + as + S + V = although...

question: Câu 631: An endangered species is a type of organism (631) ____ is threatened by extinction.
explanation: that thay thế cho organism (vật).

question: Câu 632: Dinosaurs, (632) ____, lost their habitat about 65 million years ago.
explanation: for instance: ví dụ.

question: Câu 633: ... most likely because of an asteroid (633) ____ the Earth.
explanation: striking: đâm vào (rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ).

question: Câu 634: This can happen in (634) ____ different ways.
explanation: a number of + N số nhiều.

question: Câu 635: To “clear” a piece of land is to remove all trees and (635) ____ from it.
explanation: vegetation: thảm thực vật (không đếm được).

question: Câu 636: What is the passage mainly about?
options: History of cities all over the world
Types of cities in the world
Contributions of cities to the world
explanation: Bài nói về vai trò và đóng góp của thành phố.

question: Câu 637: Which of the following is NOT true according to the writer?
options: Humanity transitioned from a rural to a primarily urban species at breathtaking speed.
Cities are the dominant form of human civilization in the 21st century.
There is a tendency for cities to connect to form large urban regions.
People should not be too optimistic about the future of cities.
explanation: Tác giả lạc quan về tương lai của thành phố.

question: Câu 638: The phrase "flex their muscles" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ____.
explanation: flex one's muscles = show strength/power.

question: Câu 639: Would the following sentence best be placed at the end of which paragraph? - “This is neither fair nor rational.”
explanation: Phù hợp nhất ở cuối đoạn 1 (vẫn do quốc gia quyết định dù thành phố phát triển mạnh).

question: Câu 640: The word "they" in paragraph 4 refers to ________.
explanation: they = cities (Cities channel creativity... they drive growth).

question: Câu 641: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to resist negative peer pressure.
explanation: Bài tập trung vào các tác động (tích cực & tiêu cực) của peer pressure.

question: Câu 642: In paragraph 1, who or what does the word “they” refer to?
explanation: they = A person affected by peer pressure.

question: Câu 643: According to the passage, what is the negative effect of peer pressure?
options: It could lead you to try alcohol or drugs, skip school...
It can lead to high stress levels, negative behavior.
You can lose your lifestyle and entirely adopt your peers' way of living.
It may lead you to follow what your peers feel right.
explanation: Negative peer pressure dẫn đến giảm tự tin, kết quả học kém, trầm cảm, lo âu...

question: Câu 644: In paragraph 4, what is the word “depression” closest in meaning to?
explanation: depression ≈ unhappiness (trầm cảm, buồn bã).

question: Câu 645: According to the passage, what is the expression of peer pressure?
options: Distancing from family members and friends.
Changing music style to conform to the group's actions.
explanation: Peer pressure khuyến khích thay đổi để phù hợp với nhóm (ví dụ: taste in music).

question:
Câu 646: Mary is responsible for completing the budget report for the next team meeting on December 25, but she seems to be slightly behind of schedule. She asks her manager to give her three more days to finish the report. What would be the best response for her manager in this situation?
Mary: Can you give me three more days to complete the report?
The manager: ____.
options: That's a good idea! Let's do it.
The report is not informative enough for the meeting.
Well, I think you used to be a good employee in this company.
I understand, Mary. Let's set a new deadline of December 22.
explanation: Đồng ý gia hạn nhưng vẫn đặt hạn chót hợp lý trước cuộc họp.

question: Câu 647: You've noticed that every time someone walks past a particular table, the glasses on the table shake slightly. What is the likely cause?
options: The glasses are not positioned properly.
The table is wobbly and needs adjustment.
The floor is slippery near the table.
explanation: Bàn bị lung lay gây rung khi có người đi qua.

question:
Câu 648: James, your best friend, wants to invite you out for dinner. What would be the best response for James in this situation?
James: Would you like to go out for dinner tonight with me?
You: ____.
options: I know a good restaurant downtown. Let's go there.
You are welcome. That's just a small thing.
Congratulation! You really deserve the invitation.
Thanks, but I'm not hungry right now.
explanation: Chấp nhận lời mời và gợi ý địa điểm.

question: Câu 649: Which of the following statements about a book can be a fact?
options: The book is a thrilling page-turner.
The book has the most beautiful cover.
The book is the author's most inspiring work.
explanation: Năm xuất bản là sự thật có thể kiểm chứng; các lựa chọn khác là ý kiến.

question: Câu 650: You are sitting on a crowded bus, and there is no empty seat left. You notice an older person standing nearby, and you feel it would be polite to offer them the seat, but you're a little unsure of how to approach the situation. What can you say?
options: The bus is about to arrive the final stop.
It's a bit crowded, isn't it?
Would you like to take my seat?
I hope you don't mind standing.
explanation: Lời mời lịch sự và trực tiếp nhất.
